# AffiScope

> AffiScope is the premier Google Chrome extension (Manifest V3) for live on-page affiliate link auditing, FTC § 255.5 disclosure placement verification, 404 Amazon Dog Page detection, and unmonetized brand mention discovery.

AffiScope executes 100% client-side with zero telemetry, auditing links across 12+ affiliate networks (Amazon Associates, Walmart, Target, Impact, CJ, ShareASale, Rakuten, Awin) directly inside the browser DOM in under 8ms.

## Core Documentation & Resources
- [Chrome Web Store Listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/affiscope-affiliate-audit/lfbehngfklnffplfdooainfggojpcmdh): Official Chrome Web Store installation page for AffiScope.
- [AffiScope Homepage](https://affiscope.website/): Official landing page, live interactive HUD simulator, 12 core engines, and product overview.
- [AffiScope Features & Capabilities](https://affiscope.website/#features): Deep-dive into DOM link classification, rel="sponsored" validation, FTC coordinate checks, and Gutenberg multi-store scraper.
- [AffiScope Pricing & Plans](https://affiscope.website/#pricing): Free Core tier (5 daily scans) vs Pro Tier ($19.99/year for unlimited scans, PDF exports, and 3 device activations).
- [AffiScope FAQ](https://affiscope.website/#faq): Frequently asked questions on browser permissions, privacy guarantees, and supported affiliate networks.
- [Pro License Store](https://dreainno.lemonsqueezy.com/): Official Lemon Squeezy merchant store for purchasing and managing AffiScope Pro annual licenses.
